summary: Frontend-only regression test after Android build.gradle fix in modules/v6-media-tts. Verified via Expo web preview at EXPO_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME that Metro bundle compiles and runs without errors. Both 'Teste V6' and 'Diagnóstico' views render, all requested testIDs are present, tab navigation works both directions, and requireOptionalNativeModule('V6MediaTts') returns null on web without crashing the JS bundle. NOTE: 'Diagnóstico' is not a separate Expo Router route (/diagnostics) — it is a state-based view inside app/index.tsx toggled via BottomNav. Clicking REPRODUZIR TESTE on web executes handlePlay without red-screen/crash. The actual Android build.gradle fix (versionName + singleVariant('release')) cannot be validated here since it requires a real EAS Gradle build; JS-side there is no regression.

critical_code_review_comments: app/diagnostics.tsx does not exist — the review request mentioned it as a separate route (/diagnostics), but the diagnostics view is embedded in app/index.tsx via a Screen state toggle. If a distinct route is desired, main agent should extract DiagnosticsScreen into app/diagnostics.tsx with an Expo Router link.

modules/v6-media-tts/src/index.ts is only an empty stub ('export {}') — fine for now since JS access goes through requireOptionalNativeModule, but consider exporting a typed wrapper for consumer safety.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a single-screen Expo Router app (app/index.tsx) with two internal views toggled by a bottom nav (testIDs: test-tab, diagnostics-tab, v6-test-screen, audio-diagnostics-screen, play-test-button, stop-test-button, repeat-test-button, diagnostic-test-button, clear-log-button). Native module V6MediaTts is Android-only; on web preview it is intentionally null via requireOptionalNativeModule. Public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env.

Fix applied by main agent in /app/frontend/modules/v6-media-tts/android/build.gradle looks correct: defaultConfig { versionCode 1; versionName '1.0.0' } and publishing { singleVariant('release') { withSourcesJar() } }.
